from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re
html = Path('web/index.html').read_text()
# Find visible text in labels, buttons, summaries, spans with common UI classes
patterns = [
    r'<summary[^>]*>(.*?)</summary>',
    r'<label[^>]*>(.*?)</label>',
    r'<button[^>]*>(.*?)</button>',
    r'title="([^"]+)"',
    r'aria-label="([^"]+)"',
    r'class="param-gloss"[^>]*>([^<]+)',
    r'class="pb-caption"[^>]*>([^<]+)',
    r'class="layer-gloss"[^>]*>([^<]+)',
    r'class="status-label"[^>]*>([^<]+)',
]
for p in patterns:
    print('---', p[:40])
    for m in re.finditer(p, html, re.S|re.I):
        t = re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ', m.group(1))
        t = re.sub(r'\s+',' ', t).strip()

            print(' ', t)
PY
